approach.why: Both commits do what they set out to do in a way that can work. 0bd04c7: fast-check.sh runs the offline cargo check CI compiles plus tsc -b in both front ends (both tsconfigs are noEmit; widget build:check and admin-ui build already use tsc -b); run-selected-tests.sh routes widget and admin-ui vitest and playwright paths and crates/<dir> to cargo test -p, and every crates/* directory name equals its Cargo package name. 8e9f672: the redesign and the token endpoint hold together: resolveOptions keeps every prior data-* semantic; refreshToken runs at open and again at send when under 30 s remain; Send anonymously builds opts with jwt undefined so api.ts authHeaders adds no Authorization header and credentials falls to include, and the same opts reach uploadAttachments; showSent destroys the attachments controller first, keeps closeBtn, esc and the focus trap (trapFocus queries live via getFocusable), and submitBtn stays disabled on success so Ctrl/Cmd+Enter cannot resend; dist/widget.js is rebuilt from this source (contains data-token-url, fbm-chips, fbm-sent, no fbm-toast) and its 32,773 B total is exactly 30,720+2,053 as the message claims. Test lens, ruling on both VER-32 flags: the renamed happy-path test is the old one evolved and asserts strictly more (Send disabled until a message, the POST payload kind/subject/body, axe on the confirmation, Done closes); the attachments test lost expect(dialog).toBeHidden() because the dialog no longer closes on submit and its /Thanks/i status check became an exact-text one, so neither makes a check pass more easily. The four new DEC-FBR-IMPL-35 e2e cells assert the token on the wire, no Authorization header under anonymity, the signed-out fallback and a second token fetch before an expiring send; the vitest cells assert the radio group, the disabled Send, the counter threshold, Ctrl+Enter and jwtEmail. Security lens: no path that grants or guards access changed; data-token-url is page-controlled exactly as data-jwt already was, the fetch uses credentials same-origin and only reads a string token from JSON, and the email claim is rendered through textContent. The cap raise is recorded as the owner decision in DEC-FBR-IMPL-35 and applied consistently in oracle.py, oracle.json and the project docs.

findings.summary: The API has no subject field: the first-line subject the window calls API-required is sent and dropped, yet is recorded as fact in DECISIONS, the README, a code comment and a mocked e2e assertion
findings.evidence: crates/feedbackmonk-api/src/handlers/feedback.rs:84-125 FeedbackRequest fields are body, sentiment, kind, email, crash_event_id, severity, rating; no subject, and grep deny_unknown_fields over crates/ matches only feedbackmonk-runner/src/analyst/ingest.rs, so serde ignores it. grep subject over crates/**/*.rs finds only email subjects, tenants.email_subject_prefix and an error.rs test string. widget/src/widget.ts:241-244 "The API requires a subject; ... the subject is its first line"; widget/README.md:286 says the API required subject is the first line of the message; docs/specs/DECISIONS.md:1225 "(the required subject is the message first line)"; widget/e2e/widget-a11y.spec.ts happy-path asserts sent.subject equals "How do I export my data?" against the mocked POST, a value the real server never reads. Pre-existing on the wire (widget/src/types.ts:40 since 9f1a28b), but this window writes the false premise into durable text and tests it.

findings.summary: Token refresh edge cases: a failed refresh discards a still-valid token and sends anonymously after the form said where replies go; opening awaits the endpoint with no timeout
findings.evidence: widget/src/widget.ts:162-184 refreshToken: on !r.ok, a body without token, or a thrown fetch, token stays undefined and :182 state.opts = { ...state.opts, jwt: token } runs unconditionally, so a token with 0 < ttl < 30 s is replaced by none; :263 the send path then calls submitFeedback with no Authorization while the open form shows "Replies go to <email>" (ui.ts whoField), and an auth-only project (config.auth_modes without anonymous) gets a 401 instead of a retry with the held token. widget/src/widget.ts:312-318 openModal awaits refreshToken(state) with no AbortController or timeout; a hanging token endpoint keeps the dialog from opening while state.opening is true. Neither path has a test cell.

findings.summary: The two new landing-check scripts have no program verifying their routing or exit contract
findings.evidence: scripts/run-selected-tests.sh:17-26 routes five path shapes and exits 2 on any other; :29-41 dispatches to npx vitest, npx playwright and cargo test -p. scripts/fast-check.sh:11-13 runs three commands. No test file in the tree names either script (grep run-selected-tests across tracked files matches only .claude/config.json and scripts/README.md). Mode: unit (a shell or pytest cell that puts stub npx and cargo on PATH and asserts which runner each path reaches and that an unplaceable path exits 2), owned by a new tests/scripts/ cell beside the scripts; the other behaviour in the window is covered by vitest and playwright cells and needs nothing here.
